notes: 面板改为两段式布局：页头（标题、徽标、元信息、区标签）整体移出滚动区，固定在面板顶部；下方另起独立滚动区，只装提示条与各分区卡片。滚动内容在结构上无法再穿到标题区或标题上方，区标签跳转落点固定为内容区顶部 +8px，不再按页头高度动态计算，页头换行、条件分区出现或消失都不影响落点。
notesEn: The panel is now a two-part layout: the header (title, badges, meta line, section tabs) sits outside the scroll area, pinned at the top of the panel, and a separate scrolling region below holds the notices and every section card. Content can no longer reach the header area or above it, and section jumps use a fixed offset of 8px from the top of the scrolling region instead of the header height, so header wrapping or conditional sections no longer move the landing point.
